input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every page is a list of (label, bbox, num_of_lines, text_line_height, text_line_width) specs written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: Real LayoutBlock/LayoutRegion objects were constructed and the pinned xycut_enhanced was executed end to end over fourteen synthetic pages; the helpers with subtle boundaries were additionally executed as unit cases. Nothing was transcribed.

limitations: Synthetic pages only: the corpus covers single/two column, doc_title and paragraph_title children, vision title and footnote children, header/footer, seal, centered pre-cut, cross-layout spans, vertical regions, references, and an abstract, but not multi-region pages ('region'-labeled blocks and euclidean_insert are out of scope until region-level orchestration lands).

reference_insert is pinned as a unit fixture because no synthetic page reliably reaches its cross_reference path end to end; its stale-distance quirk is reproduced, its NameError crash (first sorted block not above the reference) is refused rather than ported.
Upstream width/height/area freeze at construction and update_region_label resets a vision block's num_of_lines; both quirks are preserved, not repaired.
No model is run and no page is decoded.
